meta.parties: Natchia Et Al. v. Natchia Et Al

rules.statement: There is nothing in section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code which limits the time within which a decree can be rectified.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is nothing in section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code which limits the time within which a decree can be rectified."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code, s. 189
